newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler denies report of board changes.
newsitem.headline: Daimler denies report of board changes.

text.p: German industrial giant Daimler Benz AG denied on Wednesday magazine reports that its chief executive Juergen Schrempp is planning to give the chairman of its Mercedes car-making subsidiary a new position on the board.

A pre-release copy of a magazine article to be published on Thursday said Schrempp wanted Mercedes chairman Helmut Werner to take up the position of financial controller on the re-formulated Daimler board.

But Daimler spokesman Roland Klein dismissed the report in the German business magazine Wirtschaftswoche. "This kind of speculation is humbug," Klein said, adding that discussions on reforming the structure of the company continued.
Klein said it was well-known that a restructuring of the group would lead to reform of the structure of the board.
The restructuring programme is aimed at quickening the decision-making process and improving efficiency. Decisions on the outcome are due this year, but Daimler said it was under no time pressure.
